name: 10954 · Nanuet, NY
findings: ZIP 10954 (Nanuet) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10954 (Nanuet) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10954 (Nanuet) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
